##### Project general facts

Celia Gardens is a residential building by Abou Eid within the Nad Al Sheba Gardens masterplan, offering a calm and green setting for everyday living. The project features one- and two-bedroom apartments designed with practical layouts and a contemporary architectural character, providing a comfortable home for professionals, couples and families who value a quieter residential atmosphere.

The amenity offer covers wellness, leisure and work. Residents have access to adult and kids' swimming pools, indoor and outdoor gyms, a sauna and steam room and a yoga room. Leisure options include an outdoor cinema, a jogging track, a padel court, a barbecue area and an entertainment lounge with a café, while indoor and outdoor kids' areas cater to families. A business centre provides a professional setting within the building.

Apartments are delivered semi-furnished, with contemporary finishes that create a clean and comfortable interior ready for personal touches.

##### Location descript    ion and benefits

Nad Al Sheba 1 is a residential neighbourhood in central Dubai, known for its green landscaping, family-oriented atmosphere and close proximity to Meydan. The Nad Al Sheba Gardens masterplan combines residential communities with landscaped open spaces, offering a calm environment within easy reach of the city's main districts.

Al Ain Road and Meydan Racecourse are a short drive away, while Downtown Dubai and Dubai Hills Mall are also within close reach. Dubai International Airport is easily accessible, connecting residents to the city's key business, retail and travel hubs.

Freehold ownership is available to international buyers. The combination of a central location, green surroundings and strong connectivity positions the area for both end users and investors seeking well-connected apartment living in Dubai.
